audit.title: SEO audit at the founding rate
audit.body: A bounded review that connects each finding to a recommended fix and a way to verify the result.
audit.priceAriaLabel: Intro audit price 99 dollars, normally 149 dollars
audit.rateNote: The $99 founding rate is available during the introductory period.

items.title: Findings
items.body: Observed technical, on-page, content, or local-search issues with the evidence behind them.

items.title: Prioritized fixes
items.body: Recommended actions ordered by relevance and dependency, not an unexplained score.

items.title: Verification steps
items.body: Checks that show whether each implemented fix produced the intended change.

next.title: Scope continuing work from the evidence
next.body: Retainers are available when ongoing implementation or review is useful. Scope is agreed after the audit, once the work is known.
next.credit: If you continue with a retainer, the audit fee is credited to the first retainer month.
next.partner: Agency and white-label engagements follow a separate partner discussion. Partner rates are not published.
next.ladder: The audit produces a written report and a 45-minute walkthrough. From there, there are three honest paths: implement the fixes yourself, take a fixed-scope repair engagement, or move to monthly delivery. All three are priced in writing after the audit, when the work is actually known.
